title: Dynamic discovery is the management architecture
summary: Management is a discovery/router layer, not a master catalogue of cloud, machine, service, network, MVS, GPU, LLM or RexxOS semantics. Every fresh request rediscovers current specialist surfaces and may retain several relevant specialists at once.
invariants: The top-level resolver must not contain a permanent provider/domain action catalogue.
Each domain owns discovery of its current objects and its own relevance semantics.
Fresh discovery is authoritative; the LLM must not carry operational state between turns.
A request may legitimately compose multiple specialists rather than selecting one winner.
Unavailable specialist capability disappears or fails closed on the next discovery refresh.
Original ooRexx objects are preserved by identity instead of being flattened into provider strings.

provenance.claim: Current r13196-qualified Management increment with transient Mesh dev8 events/correlation/freshness specialist.
